Growing At Ludicrous Speed
18 Mar 2016: Gasoline and diesel demand are the mainstay of the oil markets worldwide, as the transport sector accounts for more than half of all of global oil demand. Worldwide population growth and rapid economic progress in developing countries are expected to underpin further growth in transportation fuels.
